name: Techvoot App Firebase
author: Techvoot Solutions

sections.description:
The Techvoot App Firebase plugin seamlessly integrates your WordPress store with the Techvoot App Firebase Firestore database. It enables real-time synchronization of user data and other relevant information between Firebase and your WordPress site, ensuring a smooth and efficient data flow.

Additionally, the plugin offers Firebase user notification functionality, allowing you to send automated notifications to users based on a cron job. This ensures that your users receive timely updates without any manual effort.

Whether you’re running an eCommerce store, membership site, or a custom web application, this plugin provides the essential bridge between WordPress and Firebase Firestore.

Key Features
– Seamless Firebase Firestore Integration – Connect your WordPress store to the Techvoot App Firebase Firestore database with ease.
– Automatic User Data Sync – Keep user data updated between Firebase and your WordPress site in real time.
– Custom Data Synchronization – Sync additional relevant information such as orders, profiles, and custom metadata.
– Firebase User Notifications – Automatically send push notifications to users based on cron jobs.
– Scheduled Notifications – Set up periodic notifications without manual intervention.
– Secure Connection – Ensure safe and encrypted data exchange between your WordPress site and Firebase.
– Easy Configuration – No coding required! Simply enter your Firebase credentials and configure sync settings in a few clicks.
– Performance Optimized – Designed for speed and efficiency, ensuring minimal impact on website performance.
– Compatible with WordPress & WooCommerce – Works seamlessly with standard WordPress setups and WooCommerce stores.

Short Description

Techvoot App Firebase Plugin seamlessly integrates your WordPress site with Firebase Firestore for real-time data sync and automated user notifications. Effortlessly sync user data, orders, and custom metadata while ensuring secure and optimized performance. Ideal for eCommerce, membership sites, and custom applications—no coding required! 🚀
sections.installation:
1. Activate the Plugin:
    Log in to your WordPress Admin Dashboard.
    Navigate to Plugins > Installed Plugins.
    Find Techvoot App Firebase and click Activate.

  2. Configure the Plugin:
    Go to Settings > Techvoot App Firebase and enter your Firebase credentials, including:

Firebase Database Name
Firebase API Key
Firebase Notification Server Key
